sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • Vitamin B12 testing (CPT code 82607*) IS REIMBURSABLE once every 90 days and IS ONLY REIMBURSABLE in any of the following situations: – For individuals with a documented vitamin B12 deficiency – For individuals with any of the following clinical manifestations or risk factors of vitamin B12 deficiency: ▪ Cutaneous ­ Hyperpigmentation ­ Jaundice ­ Vitiligo ▪ Gastrointestinal ­ Glossitis ▪ Hematologic ­ Leukopenia ­ Macrocytic or megaloblastic anemia ­ Pancytopenia ­ Thrombocytopenia ­ Thrombocytosis ▪ Neuropsychiatric ­ Areflexia ­ Cognitive impairment ­ Gait abnormalities ­ Irritability ­ Loss of proprioception and vibratory sense ­ Olfactory impairment ­ Peripheral neuropathy ▪ Decreased ileal absorption ­ Crohn’s disease ­ Ileal resection ­ Patients with decreased absorption following surgical procedures ­ Tapeworm infection ▪ Decreased intrinsic factor ­ Atrophic gastritis ­ Pernicious anemia ­ Postgastrectomy syndrome ▪ Genetic ­ Transcobalamin II deficiency ▪ Inadequate intake ­ Alcohol abuse ­ Eating disorder ­ Individual with cognitive decline or being evaluated for dementia ­ Veganism or vegetarianism ▪ Prolonged medication use ­ Long term drug therapy ­ Long term use of metformin
